description: A couple trades places under a raised arch, the left-hand dancer turning under.

walkthrough.line: Take inside hands with {who}, raise them, and trade places under the arch.
walkthrough.teach: Join inside hands with {who} and raise them into an arch. The dancer on the left turns under it while the other walks forward and round the outside, and the two of you trade places. You end side by side again, facing back the way you came, hands joined the whole way through.
